title: Heedlessness
body:
The first Fard in worshipping is cleanliness, to say: 'Audhu bi-llahi mina
shaitani rajim'. Actions are judged according to the intentions behind them.
Before doing anything this must be said so the action is for the sake of
Allah. Also the 500 Halal (listed good actions) must be said with 'Audhu
bi-llahi mina shaitani rajim', each Rakaat, not only the first, because
Shaitan always approaches in each new Rakaat and he sends thoughts to the
one who prays. Shaitan is the reason that the servant doesn't come close to
Allah (qurb) and gets away from Him. Don't be heedless!
Damaskus - 17.04.2002
